 jobs:
@@ -13,11 +12,26 @@ jobs:
     steps:
       - uses: actions/checkout@v4
 
+      - name: Check Cloudflare credentials
+        id: cf
+        env:
+          CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}
+          CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID }}
+        run: |
+          if [ -z "$CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN" ] || [ -z "$CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID" ]; then
+            echo "skip=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+            echo "::warning::CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN or CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID missing. Deploy skipped."
+          else
+            echo "skip=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+          fi
+
       - name: Install dependencies
+        if: steps.cf.outputs.skip == 'false'
         run: npm install
         working-directory: minimax/music-2-6
 
       - name: Deploy Minimax Worker
+        if: steps.cf.outputs.skip == 'false'
         uses: cloudflare/wrangler-action@v3
         with:
           apiToken: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}
@@ -37,10 +51,12 @@ jobs:
